title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
article: This movie is a great continuation of the classic movie Beetlejuice. I think this movie is a 10/10 because first of all the way they made the claymation the same as the classic is just so cool. For example the sand worm (which is the black and white beast in this sand like area where the sand worm is) looks exactly as it was before and I thought that was pretty awesome. Something that I liked about the movie was the fact that they used some of the same actors from the original and brought in some new ones like Jenna Ortega. My personal favorite character was Bob because it was funny and sad how he dressed up as Beetlejuice and risked his life just because Beetlejuice had to escape. R.I.P. Bob. Speaking of Beetlejuice, he was great as always, and was the same type of character he was last time. His name got called three times because Lydia Deetz (Winona Ryder) needed to help her daughter Astrid Deetz (Jenna Ortega) because Jeremy Frazier (Arthur Conti) took Astrid to the Neitherworld waiting room to swap her life for his. Lydia might not show it, but Beetlejuice can be helpful sometimes. Once Jeremy almost got away with swapping bodies with Astrid but when Beetlejuice got involved he dropped him into a hole of spikes. Or when Lydia was dating Rory (Justin Theroux) who was acting nice but Beetlejuice knocked the truth out of him. I'm pretty sure he did it for the money and other things that I sadly do not remember. Anyway a lot of the movie they talk about Delia Deetz’s (Catherine O’Hara) husband Charles Deetz died by a shark biting off his head. Thank you for listening to my opinion of Beetlejuice Beetlejuice, and don’t say it three times!
author: Greyson Geldwerth
